parole.significato: A person of the Hittite Kingdom, a Bronze Age kingdom of Anatolia.
parole.testo: From Biblical Hebrew חִתִּי (ḥittî), from Hittite 𒄩𒋾 (ḫati), perhaps ultimately an exonym related to Hatti.
